title: 初三短对话：背包与油漆
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听五段短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍。原卷未印精确停顿，本机每题听前后各5秒，只作审阅编排。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Why do you carry a pencil instead of using your phone for notes?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The phone distracts me. When I write with a pencil, I do not stop to check messages.

questions.stem: Why does the boy prefer a pencil for notes?
questions.rationale: A：明确避免查消息分心；B：未说手机损坏；C：未比较携带方便

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Did you leave your backpack in the music room, Zoe?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That is not mine. Mine has a yellow strap. The one with the red strap is Liam's, and the green one belongs to Sam.

options: The one with a red strap.
The one with a green strap.
The one with a yellow strap.
questions.rationale: A：是Liam的；B：是Sam的；C：明确mine yellow strap

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will the school yard be open this afternoon?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, workers are painting the lines. It will open again tomorrow morning, unless it rains tonight.

questions.stem: Why is the school yard closed?
questions.rationale: A：未下雪；B：明确paint lines；C：未有演出

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I keep forgetting names when people introduce themselves.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Try using the person's name once in your reply. It helps me connect the name with the face.

options: Ask everyone to wear a badge.
questions.rationale: A：未让戴名牌；B：与建议相反；C：明确在回复中用一遍名字

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Did you enjoy making the class film?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Very much. I liked choosing the music most. Carrying the camera was tiring, and we had to rewrite the ending twice.

questions.stem: What did the boy enjoy most?
questions.rationale: A：明确liked most；B：说搬相机累；C：重写两次未说最喜欢
